life_summary: Gary Eugene Stevenson was born on August 6, 1955, in Ogden, Utah. He grew up in northern Utah and developed business acumen that led to a successful career in commerce and entrepreneurship. Before his full-time appointment in the Church's leadership, Stevenson built expertise in business operations and organizational management. He married Lesa Jean Higley in the Idaho Falls Idaho Temple, establishing a family partnership grounded in shared religious values. His professional accomplishments and business success prepared him for administrative responsibilities within Church governance while allowing him to bring practical experience from the private sector.
church_summary: Stevenson served as a missionary in the Japan Fukuoka Mission during the mid-1970s, gaining cross-cultural experience and language skills. He later served as president of the Japan Nagano Mission from 2004 to 2007, demonstrating a sustained commitment to Japan and Japanese culture within the Church context. He was called to the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles in 2015. His ministry has drawn on his business background to address Church organizational matters and administrative initiatives. His teachings and leadership style reflect an emphasis on efficient management and practical implementation of Church programs in diverse international settings.
